"""Map which test files reach the launcher, and how (W2-60a design batch). Never reads tests/acceptance/W2-60a."""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-60a")
SKIP = ROOT / "tests" / "acceptance" / "W2-60a"
PATTERNS = {
    "imp_launcher": re.compile(r"gov\.launch\.launcher|from gov\.launch import launcher|import_module\([\"']gov\.launch"),
    "names": re.compile(r"from gov\.launch\.launcher import ([^\n]+)"),
    "call_launch": re.compile(r"\blaunch\("),
    "cli_launch": re.compile(r"[\"']launch[\"']\s*,|gov launch "),
    "fake_cli": re.compile(r"\.local/bin/claude|\.local[\"'],\s*[\"']bin|CLI_REL"),
    "roles": re.compile(r"kernel/roles|\.claude/agents|[\"']roles[\"']"),
    "skills": re.compile(r"\.claude/skills|kernel/skills"),
    "build_settings": re.compile(r"build_settings\("),
    "check_args": re.compile(r"_check_cli_args\("),
    "live": re.compile(r"live|GOV_LIVE|skipif", re.I),
    "argv": re.compile(r"argv|args\.txt|sys\.argv"),
}

for base in sys.argv[1:]:
    for path in sorted(Path(base).rglob("*.py")):
        if SKIP in path.parents:
            continue
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        hits = {k: len(p.findall(text)) for k, p in PATTERNS.items() if k != "names"}
        if not (hits["imp_launcher"] or hits["cli_launch"] or hits["build_settings"]):
            continue
        names = sorted({n.strip() for m in PATTERNS["names"].findall(text) for n in m.strip("()").split(",")})
        tests = len(re.findall(r"^\s*def test_", text, re.M))
        short = {k: v for k, v in hits.items() if v}
        print(f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)} tests={tests} {short} names={names}")
